categories.name: Elective module: complementary subject
categories.note: Module 20, 8 ECTS; choose M20a 'Medizin, Pharmakologie, Berufsethik, Berufsrecht' if you aim for the psychotherapy master

summary: PO 2021 section 8: modules 1 to 19 (systematics and methods, foundations, applied fields) are all compulsory; the only choice is the 8-ECTS complementary subject (module 20), plus a 13-ECTS internship and the 12-ECTS thesis. For the psychotherapy route M20a and specific internships are required.
